name: Mount Washington Alpine
terrain_source: NRCan HRDEM 1 m lidar mosaic, gaps from MRDEM 30 m (Open Government Licence - Canada) (30 m 100%, 1 m lidar 0%)
links_notes: 2024-25 trail map (skimap.org 30655): Gold Rush Glades (Gold Digger, Paydirt) lie west of the summit and are skied to from the top of Eagle Express; D1 Trees from the same top; the Outback glades (Copper Glades) from the top of Boomerang; the run Boomerang stops 48 m short of Crikey; the other Gold Rush glades (Slag Heap, Hot Shots, Tailings) and Fools Gold start along the same ridge as Paydirt, a little lower; West Basin stops 53 m above Dingo
